stem:
Leela measures a glass stopper. Its mass is 22 g and its volume is 10 cm³.

What is the density of the stopper?

options.text: The density of the stopper is 2.2 g/cm³.
The mass of the stopper is 2.2 g/cm³.
The density of the stopper is 22 g/cm³ because volume need not be used.
The density is 2.2 g/cm³ for any glass object of any size.

teacher.key_rationale: Density equals mass divided by volume: 22 g ÷ 10 cm³ = 2.2 g/cm³. Calling that value mass, dropping volume, or applying it to every glass object miss the relationship.
